newsitem.title: USA: Pharmaceutical Formulations in supply agreement.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical Formulations in supply agreement.

text.p: Pharmaceutical Formulations Inc said Thursday it has entered a supply agreement with A&S Pharmaceutical Corp, the second largest private label manufacturer of aspirin in the nation.
The company said the agreement is expected to add over $5 million in revenue and cash flow in fiscal 1998.
Pharmaceutical said the agreement with A&S, a privately-held, Bridgeport, Connecticut-based company, also enables it to offer its customers a complete range of aspirin products.
A&S Pharmaceutical manufactures private label as well as its own brand name aspirin, Certified Brand, which is sold domestically as well as in Eastern Europe, South America and Asia, it said.
